result.brief: 将 JEPA 潜空间预测范式迁移到次季节至季节尺度天气预报，只预测可预测的慢变分量，在 5-6 周指标上超过 ECMWF 物理集合。
result.reason: Applies JEPA latent-space predictive architecture to subseasonal forecasting, a representation-learning contribution in the JEPA self-supervised family, though domain is weather rather than vision/video.
